units.source_text: 带着这样的头脑仰望金阁，金阁就不仅从我的眼睛，甚至恍如从我的头脑深深地渗透进来。

en.t: Looking up at the Golden Pavilion with such a mind, the Golden Pavilion seemed to seep deeply into me not only through my eyes, but even through my very mind.

units.source_text: 这种头脑遇干旱而发热，

en.t: This kind of mind grew hot when it met with drought,
and when it met the evening breeze, it instantly became cool again.
